svg.title: Continuous batching, and the KV page table
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Continuous batching, and the KV page table” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn whiteboard with two eight-row request timelines: under static batching seven rows finish early and the rest of each row is dashed idle until a red barrier at the longest request, giving 402 tokens a second; under continuous batching new requests fill each row the moment it frees, giving 934. Below, the KV cache region is drawn twice - once with three sequences pre-allocated to max_model_len and most of each block hachured red as waste, struck through, and once as thirty small 16-token blocks allocated out of order with one amber block shared between two sequences - annotated as the week 9 page table. At the bottom a throughput curve rises and flattens while per-request tokens per second falls, crossing near concurrency 32.
